summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due October 14, 2030, tied to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Russell 2000 Index and S&P 500 Index. The notes pay a monthly $8.33 contingent coupon if the worst-performing underlying closes at or above its coupon barrier, autocall monthly from April 9, 2027, and are senior unsecured obligations. This is a routine structured medium-term note takedown, not a special situation; watch index levels versus barriers and Jefferies credit risk.
